name: Hunters & Treasures
addr: 217 E State St, Black Mountain, NC 28711
hours: Mon 10 AM–6 PM; Tue 10 AM–6 PM; Wed 10 AM–6 PM; Thu 10 AM–6 PM; Fri 10 AM–6 PM; Sat 10 AM–4 PM; Sun Closed

reviews.t: If you use a credit card card here it would be wise to lock it and change your card number immediately. I bought some Ruger magazines from Roger on May 30, 2026 and returned them about 3 hours later on the same day because they did not match what they said on the package and did not fit my gun. He instead of refunding the $68.12 to my card he charged it again and then he ran my card again to refund that, all seemed good but then 3 weeks later my card was charged again for $68.12 called him and he said he didn't do it. Contacted my bank and they took care of it, then about 1 week later $68.12 was charged again from same place and again I contacted the bank and had it removed, the bank told me that the $68.12 was requested from hunters treasures with a few different names and ways thats why they kept processing them, this was charged to my card 4 different times. This is very untrustworthy and not the way a business should be ran. I wonder how many other people have been double charged or may even more and not noticed it.
Very friendly atmosphere with some incredible equipment. You name it and I’m sure they can either have it or get you damn close to what your after

The Staff is very helpful and knowledgeable about what they sell. The prices are fair. And they have plenty of options to choose from. I have been going there for the past 7 years, and I have never had a bad experience. GREAT SPOT!

I've known Roger and Tk for years and actually went to school with Tk. I've supported the local business. I was denied a loan for whatever reason on a real gold chain. I was totally blown away by it. Won't be doing business with them again..
Great guy Roger runs an honest business you can trust what he says

I purchased an expensive product online based solely upon trust. I received the item in better shape than described- and it was sent very quickly. The owner and staff were awesome- very professional and courteous. I would highly recommend Hunters and Treasures as a reliable and honest business with great prices. W.Lincoln MD

I would give it a zero if I could. The guy that helped me was really not to interested in selling anything, then when punched item was given the box and ....and see-ya later as he went to help someone else (as they walk through the store). Then as I was still boxing my item I had to move for the next customer. Will not EVER use this place for ANYTHING!!!!!!

This is not a pawn shop. I went with things that are worth well over the price of the LOAN i was asking for and they said they could not. Im not sure why I was turned away. I made clear that I wanted just a loan. I guess this is more of a treasure shop... Strike the pawn and it would make sense.
Great store! Ran and owned by great people. A staple in our community. Thanks Roger 👌 …

I have been shopping in this store since it opened. The owner is professional, honest and courteous. The prices are usually more than fair. Sometimes I loose track of time hunting for treasures in this store.
